newsitem.title: POLAND: Rolimpex buys Ketrzyn sugar refinery.
newsitem.headline: Rolimpex buys Ketrzyn sugar refinery.

text.p: Polish food trader Rolimpex SA has extended its investment in the sugar industry by buying the Ketrzyn sugar refinery in northen Poland, Rolimpex's deputy president said on Wednesday.
"We have bought 100 percent of the shares in the Ketrzyn refinery. The deal included debt-for-equity arrangements," Andrzej Budzynski told Reuters, declining to give more details.
Budzynski said Rolimpex, which also owns the Dobre refinery in central Poland, was considering further purchases of sugar companies.
"We are the main trader on the sugar market and we have never concealed the fact that we want to enter the industry as an owner," he said.
Ketrzyn has a daily processing capacity of 2,000 tonnes of sugar beets and produced 18,000 tonnes of sugar in the 1996-97 season.
Poland produced 2.1 million tonnes of sugar in that season.
